4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.

7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

<script>
const canvas=document.getElementById('farm'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const W=960,H=600,COLS=8,ROWS=5,TILE=62,GAP=4,OX=333,OY=221;
const crops={carrot:{name:'Carrot',emoji:'🥕',seed:8,sell:14,days:2,color:'#ef9c43'},tomato:{name:'Tomato',emoji:'🍅',seed:12,sell:22,days:3,color:'#e97650'},sunflower:{name:'Sunflower',emoji:'🌻',seed:16,sell:32,days:4,color:'#e6b849'},berry:{name:'Strawberry',emoji:'🍓',seed:15,sell:28,days:3,color:'#d96b71'}};
const weatherTypes=[{name:'Sunny',icon:'🌤️'},{name:'Cloudy',icon:'☁️'},{name:'Rainy',icon:'🌧️'}];
let game={day:1,money:120,season:0,weather:0,tool:'plant',selected:'carrot',inventory:{carrot:6,tomato:4,sunflower:3,berry:3},plots:[],quests:[],daily:{planted:0,watered:0,harvested:0},sound:true};
let hover=-1,toastTimer,particles=[];
function freshPlots(){return Array.from({length:COLS*ROWS},()=>({crop:null,watered:false,ready:false,age:0}))}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem('littleAcreSave',JSON.stringify(game))}catch(e){}}
function load(){try{const s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('littleAcreSave'));if(s&&s.plots?.length===COLS*ROWS)game={...game,...s,plots:s.plots,daily:s.daily||{planted:0,watered:0,harvested:0}}}catch(e){} if(!game.quests?.length)makeQuests();}
function toast(msg){const el=document.getElementById('toast');el.textContent=msg;el.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'),2100)}
function beep(freq=520){if(!game.sound)return;try{const ac=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(),o=ac.createOscillator(),g=ac.createGain();o.frequency.value=freq;o.type='sine';g.gain.setValueAtTime(.055,ac.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,ac.currentTime+.12);o.connect(g);g.connect(ac.destination);o.start();o.stop(ac.currentTime+.13)}catch(e){}}
function resize(){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),d=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.round(r.width*d);canvas.height=Math.round(r.height*d);ctx.setTransform(canvas.width/W,0,0,canvas.height/H,0,0);draw()}
function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r,fill,stroke){ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);if(fill){ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill()}if(stroke){ctx.strokeStyle=stroke;ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke()}}
function ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,fill){ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill()}
function line(x1,y1,x2,y2,color,width=2){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.stroke()}
function draw(){if(!ctx)return;ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
 // meadow
 ctx.fillStyle='#a8c987';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 for(let y=10;y<H;y+=48)for(let x=(Math.floor(y/48)%2)*24;x<W;x+=48){ctx.fillStyle='#b4d19355';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+5,y+11,1.3,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+19,y+26,1,0,7);ctx.fill()}
 // distant hedgerow and hills
 ctx.fillStyle='#8db77f';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,130);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(100,77,210,119);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(360,66,490,117);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(655,62,790,115);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(880,80,960,107);ctx.lineTo(960,157);ctx.lineTo(0,157);ctx.fill();
 // background fence
 for(let x=28;x<935;x+=42){if(x>305&&x<870)continue;line(x,169,x,199,'#a97c4a',5);line(x-4,178,x+4,178,'#cfaa70',2)}line(0,176,302,176,'#c1935b',5);line(875,176,960,176,'#c1935b',5);
 // path
 ctx.fillStyle='#d9c99f';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,444);ctx.bezierCurveTo(210,405,235,467,399,451);ctx.bezierCurveTo(622,429,741,467,960,428);ctx.lineTo(960,550);ctx.bezierCurveTo(710,586,573,521,388,547);ctx.bezierCurveTo(209,573,137,518,0,564);ctx.fill();
 // path pebble marks
 for(let i=0;i<48;i++){let x=(i*173+31)%960,y=450+((i*71)%112);ellipse(x,y,2+(i%3),1.5,'#bba97e77')}
 // trees and shrubs at margins
 drawTree(94,206,.92);drawTree(187,157,.64);drawTree(885,200,.88);drawTree(800,144,.57);drawBush(35,398);drawBush(935,387);drawBush(259,502);
 // farmhouse
 drawHouse(105,270);
 // little flower patch
 for(const [x,y,c] of [[267,230,'#f3d16f'],[283,249,'#e77e83'],[293,219,'#fff0c4'],[302,261,'#e77e83'],[247,269,'#f3d16f']])drawFlower(x,y,c);
 // small pond
 drawPond(870,337);
 // plot board edging
 roundRect(OX-9,OY-9,COLS*(TILE+GAP)-GAP+18,ROWS*(TILE+GAP)-GAP+18,13,'#795d3b');
 roundRect(OX-5,OY-5,COLS*(TILE+GAP)-GAP+10,ROWS*(TILE+GAP)-GAP+10,10,'#c5a36d');
 for(let i=0;i<game.plots.length;i++){const x=OX+(i%COLS)*(TILE+GAP),y=OY+Math.floor(i/COLS)*(TILE+GAP),p=game.plots[i];
   roundRect(x,y,TILE,TILE,7,p.crop?'#80593e':'#966a48');
   roundRect(x+3,y+3,TILE-6,TILE-6,5,p.crop?(p.watered?'#604a38':'#76543d'):(game.weather===2?'#785945':'#805b3e'));
   // soil ridges
   for(let z=0;z<3;z++)line(x+8,y+13+z*17,x+TILE-8,y+13+z*17,p.crop?'#8a6447':'#a07751',1);
   if(p.crop)drawCrop(x+TILE/2,y+TILE/2,p);
   else if(i===hover&&game.tool==='plant')roundRect(x+5,y+5,TILE-10,TILE-10,5,'#e7d19933','#f8eab9');
   if(p.crop&&p.watered){ellipse(x+TILE-11,y+10,5,5,'#91d7df');ellipse(x+TILE-12,y+9,1.4,1.4,'#e7ffff')}
   if(p.crop&&p.ready){ctx.fillStyle='#fff3aa';ctx.font='16px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('✦',x+TILE-11,y+14)}
 }
 // shed, sign and well
 drawShed(855,450);drawSign(286,400);
 // floating sparkles
 for(const p of particles){ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/32);ctx.fillStyle=p.color;ctx.font='16px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('✦',p.x,p.y);ctx.globalAlpha=1;p.y-=.7;p.life--}particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);
}
function drawTree(x,y,s){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(s,s);ellipse(0,55,31,9,'#496d43');line(0,24,0,63,'#79573d',10);ellipse(-11,5,26,28,'#5e8b52');ellipse(14,-2,25,30,'#709d5b');ellipse(0,-18,24,27,'#82aa65');ellipse(-8,-21,8,7,'#a3c77a77');ctx.restore()}
function drawBush(x,y){ellipse(x,y,24,13,'#648d52');ellipse(x-13,y-5,11,11,'#75a260');ellipse(x+4,y-8,13,12,'#719a5d');for(let i=0;i<4;i++)ellipse(x-14+i*9,y-2-(i%2)*5,2,2,'#d7c46a')}
function drawFlower(x,y,c){line(x,y,x,y+11,'#5c8a4e',2);ellipse(x,y,4,4,c);ellipse(x-4,y,3,3,c);ellipse(x+4,y,3,3,c);ellipse(x,y-4,3,3,c);ellipse(x,y+4,3,3,c);ellipse(x,y,2,2,'#e7b44e')}

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D farming game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks, viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game in `index.html`, with canvas-rendered farm scenery and responsive HTML interface.
- Chose crop growing through daily watering, harvesting for coins, seed purchases, daily goals, weather, local save, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added playable farming game with four crops, 40 plots, planting/watering/harvesting/clearing, day progression, rain, shop, goals, sound toggle, reset, and localStorage persistence.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Tested planting and crop growth through two in-game days; carrot became harvest-ready.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/final-check.jpg` at 1280px viewport width.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If further changes are requested, continue from `index.html`; current implementation is ready to play.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/final-check.jpg`: Latest visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local development server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright browser testing was completed; an initial missing-browser issue was resolved by running `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`.
